title: 64-bit Sort Key for Draw Command Batching
description: DrawList uses 64-bit sort keys to minimize GPU state changes. Layout: [63-56] Pipeline/Shader ID (8 bits, most expensive — PSO switches), [55-48] Material ID (8 bits, texture binds), [47-24] Depth (24 bits, front-to-back reduces overdraw), [23-0] Mesh ID (24 bits, batch same geometry). Transparent objects use back-to-front via depth inversion. Helpers: SortKey::Opaque() and SortKey::Transparent().
whenToUse: When adding new render passes that submit draw commands. When implementing new material/shader types. When optimizing draw call performance.
whenNotToUse: For fullscreen quad passes (no sorting needed). For compute-only passes.
